01 — real attacks

March 2026. It happened.

🔴 LiteLLM — PyPI

4-line .pth payload. os.environ exfiltrated to attacker server. Thousands of keys.

🔴 Axios v1.14.1 — npm

Supply chain hijack. plain-crypto-js injected. Hundreds of millions affected.

🔴 ua-parser-js — npm

8M weekly downloads. Account stolen. Cryptominer + credential stealer.

🔴 CVE-2025-6514 — mcp-remote

437K downloads. RCE via WebSocket. Any MCP connection interceptable.

02 — the fix

The agent never holds
the credential.

Hermetic is a local daemon. Holds credentials in an encrypted vault. Makes the API call. Agent gets only the response.

08 — The difference

Every other tool returns the secret.

Other tools print tokens to terminals or return them through APIs. Every tool gives the secret to the caller.

Hermetic uses it on your behalf.

For an AI agent, this means a malicious instruction can't exfiltrate the key — because the key was never in the agent's address space to begin with.

Side by side
ToolWhat happensKey visible?
Password managersCLI → prints to stdoutYES
Secret vaultsAPI → returns in bodyYES
passGPG decrypt → stdoutYES
Agent keychainsAny UIDYES
In-memory storesToken lives in agent memoryYES
HermeticDaemon makes the call itselfNO
